adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when the parsed token payload lacks `refresh_token`, the helper forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (a dummy literal). In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed token data is merged into existing credentials via `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };`. If `tokenResponse.data.refresh_token` is this dummy value, it will overwrite the real stored `refresh_token`, and the subsequent `prisma.credential.update` will persist the corrupted refresh token. That matches the finding’s claim that later refreshes against the provider can permanently fail once the sync path is no longer used.
